Class CommandProcessorFactory

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.chat.cmd.CommandProcessorFactory
@Component public class CommandProcessorFactory extends Object
The CommandProcessorFactory type builds one CommandProcessor for an SSH session. SSH is the secure-shell protocol the client used to connect. Each command is constructed in create(). The command set is not discovered by a component scan.

  • Field Details

    • ollamaBaseUrl

      private final String ollamaBaseUrl

    • ollamaNumCtx

      private final int ollamaNumCtx
      The ollamaNumCtx field is the token window passed to load and swap commands. A positive value is sent as num_ctx. A value of 0 means those requests omit num_ctx.

  • Constructor Details

    • CommandProcessorFactory

      public CommandProcessorFactory(@Value("${spring.ai.ollama.base-url:http://localhost:11434}") String ollamaBaseUrl, @Value("${spring.ai.ollama.chat.options.num-ctx:0}") int ollamaNumCtx)
      The constructor stores the Ollama HTTP base and the token window. Ollama is the program that runs a local model. The base comes from spring.ai.ollama.base-url, and the default is http://localhost:11434. The window comes from spring.ai.ollama.chat.options.num-ctx, and the default is 0. A window of 0 means a later load request omits num_ctx.
      Parameters:
      ollamaBaseUrl - The Spring AI Ollama base URL.
      ollamaNumCtx - The spring.ai.ollama.chat.options.num-ctx value, where 0 omits that parameter.

  • Method Details

    • create

      public CommandProcessor create()
      The create method returns a new processor with this session's command set. The registered order is chat start, chat stop, help, message show, message find, message list, message lock, message unlock, and message edit. The same processor then registers clear, status, exit, ollama load, ollama stop, ollama, swap, and select-model. Ollama load and swap receive the stored base URL and the stored token window.
      Returns:
      A new processor that already holds that command set.
